findings.text: the fragment asserts 'Every head failure is also a base failure' and the manifest's landing line says 'zero added failures', but the head arm's tests/test_follower_freshness.py::test_failed_reexec_reports_once_and_keeps_the_registration is absent from the base arm's failure ids, so the recorded evidence does not show the done_when's 'no failure at head that is absent at base' (added_failure_count=1).
